The Company may redeem for cash all or any portion of the Notes (subject to certain limitations), at its option, on a redemption date on or after the later of (x) December 6, 2030 and (y) 60 days following (A) the reported topline data results, including the primary endpoint(s), following completion of prespecified analyses of the primary endpoint(s) under the respective protocols and statistical analysis plans of the FOCUS 1 and FOCUS 2 clinical trials of RAP-219 in drug resistant focal onset seizures as well as the two planned pivotal trials of RAP-219 in acute bipolar mania, or (B) in the event one or more of these trials is terminated, the reported results of the remaining trials, if any, that are completed, in each case, if the last reported sale price of the Company’s common stock has been at least 130% of the conversion price then in effect for at least 20 trading days (whether or not consecutive) during any 30 consecutive trading day period (including the last trading day of such period) ending on, and including, the trading day immediately preceding the date on which the Company provides the related notice of redemption, and subject to a beneficial ownership limitation set forth in the Indenture.
